raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- HiCache mirrors only the persistent Mamba checkpoint to host: conv state and temporal (SSM) state.
- `MambaPool` published no host-specific size, so host-budget code fell back to `get_kv_size_bytes()`, which also counts device-only speculative-verify scratch and ReplaySSM rings.
- Result: the Mamba host weight was inflated (Kimi-K3: 9.68 GB vs 5.22 GB per rank), which
  - shrank the KV share of an explicit `--hicache-size` split by device pool bytes, and
  - over-estimated host bytes in HiCache auto-sizing, lowering the auto ratio.

## Modifications

- `MambaPool.host_capacity_bytes` = conv + temporal checkpoint bytes only; consumers already prefer it over `get_kv_size_bytes()`:

| Consumer | Effect |
|---|---|
| `_split_hicache_size` (explicit `--hicache-size`, no Mamba pin) | Mamba share drops to its checkpoint bytes; KV share grows |
| `hicache_auto_size._estimate_hicache_bytes` | Mamba estimate excludes scratch and rings |
| Unified memory stack | unchanged (sets its own `host_capacity_bytes`) |

- No change to the proportional split or auto-sizing logic, and no new flag; this PR is accounting-only.
- Regression test checks that the split fed by `host_capacity_bytes` ignores spec scratch.
- Related PRs:
  - #47867 (`--hicache-mamba-size-gb`): with the pin set, this PR has no effect; unset, the default split it falls back to moves toward KV.
  - #47584 does not interact with it.

## Accuracy Tests

- Only host-memory accounting changes; model forward, kernels, state contents and transfers are untouched.

| Test suite (MI355X) | Result |
|---|---:|
| Hybrid pool assembler | 45 passed, 36 subtests passed |
| HiCache auto-sizing | 3 passed, 2 subtests passed |
| Server arguments | 347 passed, 196 subtests passed |
| Pre-commit | passed |

- The server-argument suite has 4 MuseSpark subtest failures on ROCm (`modelopt_fp4` unsupported); same on `main`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- Capacity accounting only; no throughput or latency change expected.
- Kimi-K3 c16 startup logs, 8x MI355X, per-rank Mamba allocation:

| Component | Size | Mirrored to host? |
|---|---:|---:|
| Conv checkpoint | 0.34 GB | Yes |
| Temporal checkpoint | 4.88 GB | Yes |
| Speculative SSM scratch | 4.17 GB | No |
| Speculative conv scratch | 0.29 GB | No |

| Host sizing weight | Before | This PR | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Per-rank Mamba bytes | 9.68 GB | 5.22 GB | **-46.1%** |

- The old fallback was inflated by 4.46 GB (~85% over the checkpoint size); that host budget goes back to the KV tier.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -1019,6 +1019,12 @@ def __init__(
                     f"conv_state size: {get_tensor_size_bytes(conv_state) / GB:.2f}GB, "
                     f"ssm_state size: {get_tensor_size_bytes(temporal_state) / GB:.2f}GB "
                 )
+            # HiCache host pools are sized by the conv/temporal checkpoint they copy;
+            # device-only spec verify scratch and ReplaySSM rings stay out.
+            self.host_capacity_bytes = int(
+                get_tensor_size_bytes(conv_state)
+                + get_tensor_size_bytes(temporal_state)
+            )
             if _replayssm_on:
                 logger.info(
                     f"GDN ReplaySSM ring buffers allocated "

@@ -1710,5 +1710,34 @@ def test_state_host_has_no_kv_split(self):
                 self.assertEqual(hybrid_pool_assembler._state_host_layout(), expected)
 
 
+class TestMambaHostShare(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_host_capacity_excludes_speculative_scratch(self):
+        """Spec verify scratch is device-only; counting it inflated the Mamba host share."""
+        pool = MambaPool(
+            size=8,
+            spec_state_size=8,
+            cache_params=InklingConvCacheParams(
+                shape=InklingConvStateShape(conv=[(2, 2)], temporal=(2, 2, 2)),
+                layers=[0],
+                dtype=InklingStateDType(conv=torch.float32, temporal=torch.float32),
+            ),
+            mamba_layer_ids=[0],
+            speculative_num_draft_tokens=4,
+            device="cpu",
+        )
+
+        checkpoint_bytes = (
+            pool.mamba_cache.conv[0].nbytes + pool.mamba_cache.temporal.nbytes
+        )
+        self.assertLess(checkpoint_bytes, pool.get_kv_size_bytes())
+        kv_pool = SimpleNamespace(
+            host_capacity_bytes=None, get_kv_size_bytes=lambda: checkpoint_bytes
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            hybrid_pool_assembler._split_hicache_size(10, (kv_pool, pool)),
+            (5.0, 5.0),
+        )
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
